stat-value.purpose: Tabular mono value in a StatTile.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers and autocomplete lists only.

components.name: Run button
components.description: Primary action on test pages; fixed width so the label can become a progress counter.
components.css: .ds-btn-run { background: #C6CED5; color: #1B1F23; border: 1px solid #C6CED5; border-radius: 6px; height: 36px; min-width: 148px; padding: 0 16px; font: 500 14px system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-run:hover { background: #DCE2E7; } .ds-btn-run:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E4E7EA; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stop button
components.css: .ds-btn-stop { background: transparent; color: #E4E7EA; border: 1px solid #41464B; border-radius: 6px; height: 36px; min-width: 96px; padding: 0 14px; font: 500 14px system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-stop:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-btn-stop:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E4E7EA; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Connect button
components.description: Green fill with a dark glyph.
components.css: .ds-btn-connect { background: #4CC17C; color: #0E1411; border: 1px solid #4CC17C; border-radius: 6px; height: 36px; min-width: 120px; font: 500 14px system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-connect:hover { background: #66CE92; } .ds-btn-connect:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E4E7EA; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: 36 px outlined input with the label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font: 500 13px system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #949AA0; } .ds-field input { height: 36px; background: #35393E; color: #E4E7EA; border: 1px solid #41464B; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 10px; font: 14px system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C6CED5; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Status chip
components.description: Dot + label for instrument and connection state.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #58C07A; font: 600 11.5px system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-status i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #58C07A; }

components.name: Live-output pill
components.description: Top-bar capsule for a live output; click opens its page.
components.css: .ds-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(240,112,104,0.55); background: rgba(240,112,104,0.14); color: #F07068; font: 700 11.5px system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .3px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-live:hover { background: rgba(240,112,104,0.24); } .ds-live:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F07068; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-live i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #F07068; } .ds-live span { font-weight: 500; opacity: .85; }

components.name: Stat tile
components.description: One readout in a hairline-divided measurement strip.
components.css: .ds-tile { background: #35393E; border: 1px solid #41464B; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; width: 150px; font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-eb { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .6px; color: #949AA0; } .ds-v { font: 600 20px ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; color: #E4E7EA; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -.02em; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-v small { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #949AA0; margin-left: 4px; } .ds-sub { font-size: 11px; color: #5D646A; margin-top: 3px; }

components.name: Emergency stop
components.description: The only round button; never disabled.
components.css: .ds-estop { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; background: #F07068; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #C0504A; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-estop:hover { background: #C0504A; } .ds-estop:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F07068; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The console is styled as a piece of bench equipment: aluminium panels a step above their bezel, graphite keys, hairline rules and lamps. There is deliberately no accent hue. Selection, focus and the Run button are graphite and brushed metal, which leaves the ok / warn / bad triad as the only colour on most screens — if something is coloured, a measurement or a link is telling you something. Density is tuned for information per screen rather than breathing room. The three themes are ambient light levels, not arbitrary skins; every semantic colour keeps its hue across the three and shifts only lightness.
keyCharacteristics: Near-true grey neutrals with a faint cool cast (aluminium, not paper).
Colour only for state: connection, live output, measurement verdict, data series.
Flat hairline panels; shadows only on things that float.
Monospace, tabular readouts; uppercase micro-labels above values.
Bright fills carry near-black glyphs in Mid and Dark, as high-visibility controls do on hardware.

rules.name: The Lamp Rule
rules.body: Colour appears only when it means something the operator must read: connection, live output, verdict, or a data series. No decorative colour anywhere.

rules.name: The Annunciator Rule
rules.body: Warn is a lamp, never a surface or a button. Seeing amber always means something wants attention.

rules.name: The Quiet Scan Rule
rules.body: Scan stays an outline. With no accent hue, Connect and Run are the only filled controls, and a filled Scan would outrank both.

rules.name: The Mono Number Rule
rules.body: A measured or set value is monospace with tabular figures; its unit is smaller and muted beside it.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Depth is reserved for things that float. A panel in the page is a hairline and a tone, never a shadow.

dos: Do take every colour from theme.ts palettes so all three themes move together.
Do keep semantic hues constant across themes and shift only lightness.
Do set measurements in mono with tabular figures and a muted unit.
Do use bright fills with near-black glyphs in Mid and Dark.
Do separate panels with a hairline and a tonal step.
donts: Don't introduce an accent hue for brand or decoration.
Don't use warn as a surface or button fill.
Don't fill Scan or any other secondary action.
Don't put shadows on in-page panels.
Don't hardcode colours in pages (the chart PNG background and grid in ResultsGraphModal are a known violation).
